_comment: EnviroCare social + local content calendar. Drives content-generator/meta-poster/gbp-poster. Captions are compliance-safe (correct office phone per location; the banned legacy Scorpion tracking number must never appear). Dates are seed values — the generator rolls them forward weekly.

posts.headline: Take your Huntsville yard back this summer
posts.body: Beaverdam Creek and Hampton Cove keep mosquitoes thick all season. Our 30-day yard barrier runs March–November so the patio stays usable. First application 50% off for new mosquito customers.

posts.headline: Enjoy your Birmingham backyard again
posts.body: 30-day mosquito barrier across Hoover, Vestavia, Mountain Brook and the metro. Family-owned since 1958. First application 50% off for new mosquito customers.

posts.headline: Lake days without the ticks
posts.body: Wooded lots around Lake Martin carry Lone Star and dog ticks. Our mosquito + tick program bundles both for waterfront and wooded properties.

posts.headline: No-drill termite protection for historic Huntsville homes
posts.body: Monte Sano and Twickenham homes sit on damp clay against old foundations. Sentricon® Always Active™ protects without drilling into original brick — up to $1M coverage. Free inspection.

posts.headline: How are we doing?
posts.body: If a technician took great care of your home, we'd love a quick Google review — it helps your neighbors find dependable, family-owned service. Thank you for trusting EnviroCare since 1958.

posts.headline: Fire ants in new-construction yards?
posts.body: Fresh sod in Trace Crossings and newer Shelby County builds arrives with fire-ant colonies aboard. Whole-colony treatment is available to anyone, priced by yard size.

posts.headline: Waterfront mosquito control built for the lake
posts.body: 880 miles of shoreline means standing water everywhere. Our 30-day barrier is designed for waterfront lots. First application 50% off for new customers.

posts.headline: Get ahead of fall invaders off Monte Sano
posts.body: Asian lady beetles, stink bugs, and boxelder bugs come off the ridgeline every October. Bi-monthly exterior treatments seal entry points before they get inside — 30+ pests, no contract.

posts.headline: Four generations. One promise.
posts.body: The Wedgworth family has protected Alabama homes since 1958. No one cares like EnviroCare — pest, termite, mosquito, and tick service across the whole state.
